  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MIT BLR - BTech VI Semester Makeup Examination, June -2025  
  MACHINE LEARNING [ECE-4409]  
  Marks: 50                                                                                Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           Discuss classification and regression problem used in machine learning with necessary  
  equations and notations.  
  (4)  
  A)  
  B)      Contrast between supervised and unsupervised learning algorithms with one example  
  each.                                                                                     (3)  
  
  C)      Discuss on statistical learning theory                                                    (3)  
  2)           Discuss the concept of sequential backward search with respect to feature selection?  
  (4)  
  A)  
  B)      Discuss the formulation of Support Vector Machine classification problem?                 (4)  
  C)      Discuss on radial basis function kernel used in SVM classification with necessary  
  equation?                                                                                 (2)  
  
  3)           Explain the backpropagation algorithm used in training of artificial neural networks?  
  (4)  
  A)  
  B)      Discuss the concept of maximum likelihood estimation used in Bayesian learning            (4)  
  C)      Explain the decision rule based on the class conditional density for a two-class  
  classification problem.                                                                   (2)  
  
  4)           Discuss 10-fold cross validation with a neat schematic?  
  (4)  
  A)  
  B)      Discuss on Student's t-test with computational steps?                                     (4)  
  C)      Explain precision and recall with respect to performance of a classifier?                 (2)
